# FG-DB-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`append-only-violation`](../../ops/runbooks/append-only-violation.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_event_without_an_audit_row_cannot_commit` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 変更の記録に失敗したため、変更を取り消しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The change was undone because it could not be recorded. Contact the administrator.
- id: Perubahan dibatalkan karena tidak dapat dicatat. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A transaction tried to commit a domain event (forge.events) without an audit row (forge.audit_log) in the same transaction, and the deferred constraint trigger refused the commit (SQLSTATE XF002, ADR-0016 §1). Every state change goes through forge-db's ChangeTx, which writes both; reaching this means a write bypassed ChangeTx (a bug or a manual change). Derived events (caused_by_seq set) are written by subscribers through DerivedTx without an audit row; their own checks (also XF002) refuse an event whose lineage does not follow its origin (derived_lineage), whose origin is at the depth limit 8 (derived_depth), whose root already has 100 derived events (derived_fanout), or that commits without a subscriber advancing to its origin in the same transaction (derived_progress).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `query` (the statement that committed, or the insert when the transaction ran SET CONSTRAINTS IMMEDIATE, or the derived insert for the lineage checks), `reason` (no_audit_row, or derived_lineage / derived_depth / derived_fanout / derived_progress, also in `constraint`; xf002_unknown: a CONSTRAINT name this build does not know — a newer or changed trigger, read `constraint` and `db_message`), `sqlstate=XF002` and `db_message` (names the origin or root seq). Find the writer: the root gate db-write-boundary forbids writes outside forge-db; inside forge-db every insert into forge.events must come from ChangeTx::commit. forge_audit.ddl_audit shows whether the trigger was changed recently.

## 対処 (fix)

Route the write through ChangeTx (forge-db typed command). Never disable the trigger; the change was rolled back and can be retried once fixed.
